intro.title: A software company *in Dhaka*
body: Spectrum IT Solutions Ltd. is a software company in Dhaka. Since 2012 we have built systems that help government offices and businesses serve people faster and more safely.

We design, build and run software for digital identity, smart cards, licensing, courts and public services. Our work does not stop at launch: we train staff, keep systems running and keep improving them.

items.title: Our mission
items.text: To build secure, simple technology that makes public and business services faster, clearer and easier to reach. We do it through careful engineering, strong partnerships and support that lasts long after launch.

leader.title: Meet our chairman
leader.name: Kabir Ahmed Bhuiyan
summary: Kabir Ahmed Bhuiyan is the Chairman of Spectrum IT Solutions Limited. Under his leadership, Spectrum delivers software, enterprise technology and digital transformation services to clients in Bangladesh and abroad, guided by three principles: innovation, strategic foresight and a commitment to excellence.
Beyond technology, he works in trade, humanitarian relief and social development in Bangladesh and internationally, and is widely known as the “International Envoy of Humanity”.

profile.title: Humanitarian diplomacy
body: During the global COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, Mr. Bhuiyan spearheaded nationwide humanitarian relief, distributing medical supplies, food, and protective equipment throughout Brahmanbaria district and other regions of Bangladesh. His humanitarian diplomacy extended internationally when Senator Abiola Ajimobi, the Governor of Oyo State in Nigeria, contracted COVID-19. At the request of the Nigerian government, he played a pivotal role in facilitating the supply of a Bangladeshi-produced medicine. With the intervention of Bangladesh’s Foreign Minister, Dr. A. K. Abdul Momen, the medicine and protective equipment were dispatched to Nigeria on a special government-arranged flight. This episode stands as a proud chapter in Bangladesh’s international engagement.

profile.title: Championing the “Blue Gold Economy”
body: Mr. Bhuiyan firmly believes that Bangladesh’s vast freshwater reserves can position the nation as a global hub of the “Blue Gold Economy.” Through policy papers, speeches, and published articles, he has consistently advocated for bottled water exports, water diplomacy, and investments in climate-resilient infrastructure.

profile.title: Sustainability and energy transition
body: Alongside water resource advocacy, he is deeply engaged in addressing air pollution and climate change. He has advanced forward-looking policy recommendations on sustainable energy use, urban greening, and the expansion of renewable energy. His collaborations with international research institutions and environmental organizations underscore his commitment to sustainable global development.

profile.title: Global partnerships
body: With strong ties to political leaders, business communities, and policymakers across Europe, Africa, and beyond, Mr. Bhuiyan actively leverages these relationships to strengthen Bangladesh’s trade and diplomatic partnerships worldwide.

Through the Bhuiyan Global Foundation, he supports social development initiatives, while his diversified business ventures span garments, real estate, information technology, and international trade. Additionally, through Gelence, he facilitates cross-border investment and government-focused solution initiatives.

profile.title: Business leadership
body: In addition to his business and philanthropic pursuits, Mr. Bhuiyan is actively engaged in advancing education, healthcare, environmental protection, and water resource management in Bangladesh. He also serves as the Managing Director of Bhuiyan Group UK Limited, Bhuiyan International, Bhuiyan Real Estate UK Limited, and Balance. Through these enterprises, he has cultivated long-term collaborations with global investors, business leaders, and policymakers.

In summary, Kabir Ahmed Bhuiyan is a bridge-builder between technology, humanity, and international trade. His vision and initiatives are not only shaping Bangladesh’s future but also unlocking new opportunities on the global stage.
